tutorial.slide1.row1: The goal of Mana Battle is to destroy the enemy crystal.
tutorial.slide1.row2: The enemy wants to destroy your crystal, so protect it!
tutorial.slide1.row3: Your crystal is located in the left board. The enemy, in the right board.
tutorial.slide2.row1: To help you, you can recruit units from all corners of the galaxy.
tutorial.slide2.row2: Units can only damage, shield or heal crystals, not each other.
tutorial.slide2.row3: Units can make other units faster, slower or stronger.
tutorial.slide4.row2: Protects the crystal from enemy damage
tutorial.slide5.row2: Restores your crystal's life. Every 20 heal removes 1 poison.
tutorial.slide7.row2: Damages the enemy crystal every second. Ignores Shield.
tutorial.slide8.row2: These abilities can target both units and crystals.
tutorial.slide8.row3: Makes the unit cooldown reduce at double speed.
tutorial.slide8.row4: Makes the cooldown reduce at half speed.
tutorial.slide8.row6: Increases ability power during the current battle.
tutorial.slide8.row8: Increases the chance of causing double ability power.
tutorial.slide9.row3: This symbols signals that this unit can react to other unit's abilities.
tutorial.slide10.row2: When any ally uses Haste, this unit gains 5 power.
tutorial.slide11.row3: This one reacts when an ally in the same column uses Shield.
tutorial.slide12.row2: This unit reacts to any allied effect in the same row.
tutorial.slide12.row3: Then, it applies Haste to all allies in the same column.
tutorial.slide13.row2: Some units can react to enemy actions.
tutorial.slide13.row3: This unit reacts when any enemy uses Damage.
tutorial.slide13.row4: Then, it gives 2 permanent power to the ally to its right.
tutorial.slide14.row1: Those are the basics of Mana Battle!
tutorial.slide14.row2: There's still a lot to discover.
tutorial.slide14.row3: Try getting a Gold Victory, or see how far you can get in Infinite Mode 😀
tutorial.slide14.row4: Hope you have fun playing this game!
